section1.title: Build and ship websites with AI agents
section1.p1: Traditional CMS interfaces slow down development by separating the content from the code. By using Good Website, a purpose-built ai agent cms template, you invite Claude, Pi, and Cursor directly into your project.
section1.p2: Our strict Agent-Developer Experience (ADX) instructions ensure that when you prompt an agent to build a new feature or layout, it interacts safely with your Next.js components and configuration. The agent generates the code, but you maintain the ability to review, test, and deploy every change securely.
section1.user_prompt: Make the navbar floating and rounded, and add a minimalist newsletter section.
section1.agent_response: Done! I have applied the custom theme variables and verified mobile responsiveness.

section2.title: SEO is built into the publishing foundation
section2.subtitle: When looking for the best website platforms for SEO, you need more than a generic checklist. Good Website bakes technical SEO directly into the architecture.

features.title: Automated Metadata
features.desc: Dynamic title tags, descriptions, and Open Graph data generated for every route.

features.desc: Built-in JSON-LD schema injection for rich Google results.

features.title: Core Web Vitals
features.desc: Optimized image handling, zero layout shift, and server-first rendering to ensure lightning-fast LCP.

features.title: Semantic HTML5
features.desc: Strict heading hierarchies and accessible markup by default.

section3.title: A Next.js CMS template for code-first teams
section3.p1: We have created an seo optimized nextjs cms that hands ownership back to the developer. Built on Next.js 15+ with the App Router, React Server Components, and Tailwind CSS, this template is entirely extensible.
section3.p2: Because it is a code-first repository, you do not rent your customization from a SaaS dashboard. You own the component logic, the deployment model, and the entire content lifecycle. It is the ultimate Next.js CMS template for teams that want speed without sacrificing technical control.

section4.title: Code-as-Content and the AI CMS workflow
section4.subtitle: As a true code content cms platform, we bypass the limitations of generic Markdown. Blog posts and pages are free-form HTML files powered by Tailwind utilities. This means your posts aren't just text—they are mini-applications.

steps.title: Prompt
steps.desc: Ask the agent: 'Create a pricing comparison post using a 3-column feature grid.'

steps.title: Review
steps.desc: The agent generates standard HTML directly in your src/content/posts folder.

steps.title: Validate
steps.desc: Automated tools check schema and formatting for perfect SEO scores.

steps.title: Deploy
steps.desc: Commit to git and deploy seamlessly via Vercel or Netlify.

section_multilang.title: Built-in Multi-language Support
section_multilang.p1: Our template natively supports multiple languages using Next.js i18n routing. This means you can easily expand your site's reach without complex configuration.
section_multilang.p2: Content is managed through dictionary files, allowing for seamless translation of UI elements and dynamic content.
section_multilang.p3: We also include a SmartJapaneseText component that uses BudouX to inject semantic line breaks automatically, ensuring Japanese text in headers and UI elements is always perfectly formatted.

section_contribute.title: Contribute to Good Website
section_contribute.p1: This template is open-source, and we welcome contributions! Whether you have ideas for new features, find a bug, or want to improve documentation, feel free to submit an issue or a Pull Request on GitHub.

section5.title: Why Good Website instead of a traditional CMS or drag-and-drop builder

pros.title: Who it is for
pros.desc: This is a specialized seo friendly website builder tailored for developers, indie hackers, and technical marketers who are comfortable working in a code editor and managing git repositories.

cons.title: Who it is not for
cons.desc: If you are looking for a purely visual drag-and-drop editor without touching code, a local website design service, or a turnkey hosted blog where you do not manage any configuration, Good Website is not the right fit.

section7.title: How to get started
steps: Configure your initial site metadata in config/site-meta.json.
Open the project in Cursor, or use Claude Code/Pi CLI to start building components.
Deploy the codebase directly to platforms like Vercel or Netlify.

cta.title: Ready to build faster with an AI CMS platform?

items.question: What is an AI CMS platform?
items.answer: An AI CMS platform is a content management system designed specifically to be operated, extended, and maintained by AI agents like Claude, Pi, or Cursor, rather than just humans clicking through a dashboard.

items.question: Is this a Next.js CMS template?
items.answer: Yes. Good Website is an SEO optimized Next.js CMS template using the latest App Router, React Server Components, and Tailwind CSS. It is built to be a code-first foundation for your site.

items.question: How does it improve SEO?
items.answer: It bakes technical SEO into the architecture. It automatically implements JSON-LD schema, metadata, canonical tags, and semantic HTML5, ensuring your site is search-ready by default.

items.question: Can I use Claude, Pi, or Cursor?
items.answer: Absolutely. The repository includes strict AGENTS.md instruction layers so your preferred AI agent understands exactly how to generate components, modify layouts, and create content.

items.question: Do I need to code?
items.answer: You should be comfortable with a code editor, git, and basic deployment concepts. While AI agents write the code, this is a developer-centric product where you own and review the source code.

items.question: Can I customize the content model and design?
items.answer: Yes, infinitely. Because it uses a Code-as-Content model, you aren't restricted by predefined dashboard fields. You can ask an agent to build custom React components right into your posts.

items.question: Does it replace an SEO tool?
items.answer: It replaces the need for technical SEO plugins and manual schema formatting by automating best practices, but you still need to research keywords and plan your content strategy.

items.question: Who should not use it?
items.answer: If you are looking for a purely visual drag-and-drop editor without touching code, or a turnkey hosted solution where you don't manage a GitHub repository, a traditional no-code website builder is a better fit.
